Research and implement additional cleanup targets:

DOCKER:
- Unused docker images: docker images --filter 'dangling=true'
- Stopped containers: docker ps -a --filter 'status=exited'
- Build cache: docker builder prune
- Volumes: docker volume ls --filter 'dangling=true'

PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES:
- Python pip cache: ~/.cache/pip
- Rust cargo: ~/.cargo/registry, ~/.cargo/git
- Node.js npm cache: ~/.npm
- Go module cache: ~/go/pkg/mod
- Java Gradle: ~/.gradle/caches
- Maven: ~/.m2/repository
- Ruby gems: ~/.gem

FLATPAK:
- Unused runtimes: flatpak list --runtime --app
- Unused apps
- ~/.var/app/<app>/cache

BROWSERS (Extended):
- Firefox profiles cache
- Chrome/Chromium cache
- Brave cache
- Edge cache  

SYSTEM:
- Systemd journal logs: /var/log/journal
- Core dumps: /var/lib/systemd/coredump
- Old kernels (Arch): /boot
- AUR build cache: ~/.cache/aurutils, ~/.cache/yay/*, ~/.cache/paru/*

OTHER:
- VS Code extensions cache
- JetBrains IDEs cache
- Electron app caches
- Wine prefixes temp
- Steam shader cache

notes:

9. Context not propagated - Cannot cancel operations

## MEDIUM PRIORITY (P3 - Nice to Have):

- Good package separation ✓
- Clear concerns ✓
- 3,664 lines across 12 files
- 6 internal packages
- 4 test files (good coverage)

## CONCURRENCY ISSUES:

- Permission errors not logged

See full detailed audit report for complete analysis with line numbers and recommendations.

title: Perform gap analysis to identify missing features and improvements
notes:
COMPREHENSIVE GAP ANALYSIS

Based on audit findings and comparison with mature system cleaners (BleachBit, Stacer, Bleachbit).

## FEATURE GAPS

### 1. CRITICAL MISSING FEATURES
- **No undo/restore functionality** - Backup creation incomplete (TODO at cleaner.go:292)
- **No real-time space calculation preview** - Shows stale data from last scan
- **No incremental scan** - Full rescan required, no cache invalidation strategy
- **No file preview before deletion** - Cannot see which files will be deleted
- **No progress persistence** - Scan/clean interrupted = start over
- **No scheduling/automation** - No cron integration or systemd timer support

### 2. CLEANUP TARGET GAPS (Referenced in moonbit-27)
Currently only 10 categories. Missing:
- **Docker**: Unused images, stopped containers, volumes, build cache
- **Language caches**: pip (~/.cache/pip), cargo, npm, go modules, gradle, maven
- **Flatpak**: Unused runtimes, app caches
- **Browser extensions**: Chrome/Firefox/Brave specific caches
- **IDE caches**: VS Code, JetBrains, Android Studio
- **Systemd**: Journal logs rotation, core dumps
- **Old kernels**: Arch Linux /boot cleanup
- **Wine prefixes**: Temp files in wine
- **Steam**: Shader cache, redistributables
- **Trash bins**: ~/.local/share/Trash

### 3. USER EXPERIENCE GAPS
- **No help system** - No F1 help screen in TUI
- **No search/filter** - Cannot search categories by name
- **No sorting options** - Cannot sort by size/age/risk
- **No detailed file list view** - moonbit-31 addresses this partially
- **No keyboard shortcuts legend** - Users don't know available keys
- **No confirmation customization** - Always prompts, no 'don't ask again'
- **No status indicators** - No spinner/progress percentage during ops
- **No sound/notification** - No completion alerts for long operations
- **No color themes** - themes/ package exists but unused
- **No accessibility features** - No screen reader support, high contrast mode

### 4. SAFETY & RELIABILITY GAPS
- **No integrity verification** - No checksum/hash validation
- **No scan validation** - Doesn't verify paths exist before adding to results
- **No disk space check** - Doesn't verify enough space for logs/backups
- **No permission validation** - Scans paths user can't access
- **No exclusion list** - Cannot mark files as 'never delete'
- **No minimum file age** - Could delete recently created files
- **No file type restrictions** - No way to exclude certain extensions
- **No rate limiting** - Could overwhelm slow filesystems
- **No rollback mechanism** - Backups incomplete, cannot restore

### 5. CONFIGURATION GAPS
- **No CLI config override** - Cannot specify config via --config flag
- **No environment variables** - Cannot use env vars for settings
- **No config validation on load** - Basic validation exists but incomplete
- **No config export** - Cannot backup/share configurations
- **No profile support** - Cannot have 'aggressive' vs 'safe' profiles
- **No category enable/disable persistence** - Selections not saved
- **No global enable/disable** - Cannot quickly disable all scanning
- **No whitelist/blacklist** - Cannot exclude specific paths globally

### 6. DEPLOYMENT & INSTALLATION GAPS
- **No Makefile** - Build/install/test targets missing
- **No LICENSE file** - Legal status unclear
- **No install script** - Manual binary copying required
- **No systemd service** - No daemon mode
- **No man pages** - No system documentation
- **No shell completion** - No bash/zsh/fish completions
- **No AUR package** - Not in Arch User Repository
- **No .deb/.rpm packages** - No packaging for Debian/Fedora
- **No Docker image** - Cannot run containerized
- **No GitHub releases** - No automated release workflow
- **No CI/CD pipeline** - No automated testing/builds
- **No cross-compilation** - Only builds for host arch

### 7. TESTING GAPS (From audit)
- **No integration tests** - moonbit-9: No scan→display→clean workflow tests
- **No TUI component tests** - moonbit-8: No UI interaction tests
- **No concurrency tests** - Race conditions not tested
- **No error path tests** - Happy path only
- **No performance benchmarks** - No regression detection
- **No load tests** - Unknown behavior with millions of files
- **No fuzzing** - Config/input validation not fuzzed
- **No mocking framework** - Limited test infrastructure

### 8. MONITORING & OBSERVABILITY GAPS
- **No logging framework** - fmt.Fprintf to stderr only
- **No log levels** - Cannot control verbosity
- **No structured logging** - No JSON/machine-readable logs
- **No metrics collection** - No telemetry (bytes cleaned, scan time, etc.)
- **No health checks** - No /health endpoint for monitoring
- **No crash reporting** - No panic recovery or reporting
- **No audit trail** - No record of what was deleted when
- **No statistics** - No 'total cleaned this month' etc.

### 9. DOCUMENTATION GAPS
- **README incomplete** - moonbit-19: Placeholder content only
- **No config docs** - moonbit-20: Config format undocumented
- **No API documentation** - No godoc coverage
- **No architecture diagrams** - Complex flows undocumented
- **No troubleshooting guide** - Common issues not documented
- **No FAQ** - Common questions unanswered
- **No changelog** - No version history
- **No migration guides** - No upgrade documentation
- **No examples** - No usage examples beyond basic commands

### 10. PERFORMANCE GAPS
- **No parallel category scanning** - Sequential only (workers=4 per category, not across categories)
- **No scan result caching** - Always full scan
- **No incremental updates** - Cannot rescan single category
- **No memory limits** - Could OOM on huge directories
- **No IO throttling** - Could saturate disk IO
- **No lazy loading** - Loads all results into memory
- **Size parsing inefficiency** - moonbit audit: string→int conversions in calculateSelectedSize()

### 11. SECURITY GAPS
- **No privilege dropping** - Runs as sudo for entire session
- **No secure delete verification** - Shred implementation basic
- **No sensitive data detection** - Could delete SSH keys accidentally
- **No audit logging** - No tamper-evident log
- **No permission checks** - Could delete system files if run as root
- **No sandbox/isolation** - No process isolation
- **No signed binaries** - No binary verification

### 12. CROSS-PLATFORM GAPS
- **Linux-only** - Arch-centric paths
- **No macOS support** - Different cache locations needed
- **No BSD support** - Path structures differ
- **No Windows support** - Completely different architecture needed

## COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR TOOLS

### BleachBit Features We Lack:
- 300+ cleaners (we have 10)
- Free disk space wiping
- Registry cleaning (Windows)
- Memory cleaning
- Overwrite deleted files
- Custom cleaners (XML definition)
- Encrypted shredding

### Stacer Features We Lack:
- Resource monitoring (CPU/RAM/Disk)
- Startup apps manager
- Services manager
- Package uninstaller
- Process manager
- Dashboard with system info

### What We Do Better:
- Modern TUI with Bubble Tea ✓
- Fast parallel scanning ✓
- Risk-based categorization ✓
- Clean Go codebase ✓
- Lightweight (vs Qt/Electron) ✓

## PRIORITIZED RECOMMENDATIONS

### Must Have (P0-P1):
1. Fix critical bugs from audit first
2. Complete backup/restore functionality
3. Add file detail view (moonbit-31)
4. Fix confirmation button (moonbit-32)
5. Add proper README and documentation
6. Create Makefile and install script
7. Add LICENSE file
8. Implement proper logging

### Should Have (P2):
9. Add comprehensive cleanup targets (Docker, pip, cargo, etc.)
10. Add help system in TUI
11. Implement category persistence
12. Add search/filter functionality
13. Create man pages
14. Add shell completions
15. Build AUR package
16. Add GitHub Actions CI/CD
17. Implement undo/restore

### Nice to Have (P3):
18. Theme support (themes package already exists!)
19. Add metrics/statistics
20. Implement scheduling/automation
21. Cross-platform support
22. Performance optimization
23. Advanced features (memory clean, etc.)

## TOTAL GAPS IDENTIFIED: 60+
Across 12 categories (Features, UX, Safety, Config, Deployment, Testing, Monitoring, Docs, Performance, Security, Cross-platform, Tooling)

## RECOMMENDED NEXT ACTIONS:
1. Create issues for critical gaps (backup, file preview, docs, build system)
2. Prioritize fixing audit P1 issues (channels, races, duplication)
3. Address moonbit-31 and moonbit-32 (blocking users)
4. Add cleanup targets from moonbit-27
5. Create comprehensive build/install infrastructure
6. Write documentation (README, man pages, config guide)
7. Implement theme support (code already exists!)
8. Add testing infrastructure for reliability

title: Make file scanning linear and honor duplicate-scan limits

Add correctness tests and a small performance check.

title: Make CLI and TUI cleanup outcomes safe and truthful
description: PR batch 5: align Docker and package-manager previews with executed destructive commands; preserve retryable cache entries after partial TUI cleanup; report partial scan failures; distinguish truncated files from deleted files; remove per-command debug-log side effects; refresh systemd schedule status without blocking every render. Add focused CLI and UI tests.

title: Make installer and systemd automation fail safely
description: PR batch 6: show installer task failures and return a nonzero process status, keep timer and daemon modes mutually exclusive, stop the systemd clean pre-scan from prompting, and prevent the source uninstaller from deleting package-owned files. Add failure and transition tests.
